purpose: The generated product's own src/api.ts, driven against the Python product of the same prompt, must give the results below. It checks that the React client and the Python service agree on paths, bodies, status codes, error details and list queries.
driver: som-rs/tests/react-output-v1/api_contract.mjs <product dir> <service url> <prompt.json>, run by run_api_contract.py with node.binary of toolchain.json after the product's install gate. The driver imports src/api.ts and src/schema.ts of the product; it reads no other product file.
service: The Python product of the same prompt, assembled by the live default compiler and hosted by run_api_contract.py on a QA port with a fresh PostgreSQL cluster (toolchain.json postgresql). Never 8765 or 18765. run_api_contract.py checks the cwd of every process it starts with lsof before it signals it, and stops each one.

inputs.query: QUERY of src/schema.ts, null for v1
inputs.strict: true for som.prompt.v3 and som.prompt.v4: their bodies forbid unknown members and refuse null for a field that is not nullable. v1 and v2 bodies ignore unknown members, and the database refuses null for a required field.

samples.bool: a field without a default: false for min, true otherwise; a field with a default: the negated default

row_rule: A row result passes when id is an integer of at least 1, every field equals the body member or, when the body has none, the field default, and created_at and updated_at are strings when RESOURCE.timestamps.
error_rule: An error result passes when result.ok is false and error.status and error.detail equal the step's values. error.status 0 with detail "network error" is the client's own result for a fetch that fails.
page: {limit: QUERY.pageSize, offset: 0} when QUERY is not null, otherwise {}

steps.name: create required fields
steps.call: createRow(min body: every required field, sample min)

steps.name: create every field
steps.call: createRow(full body: every field, sample full)

steps.name: get row
steps.expected: ok, equal to the full row

steps.name: list filter
steps.expected: ok, the rows whose filter field equals the value

steps.name: list before
steps.expected: ok, the rows whose date field is not null and is before 2026-02-01

steps.name: patch changed field
steps.call: patchRow(min row id, {first str field, or the first field: sample changed})
steps.expected: ok; that field changed, every other field unchanged, updated_at not earlier when RESOURCE.timestamps

steps.name: patch null on a field that is not nullable
steps.expected: strict: 422 "validation failed" with at least one field or other error; otherwise 409 "conflict"

steps.name: create missing a required field
steps.expected: 422 "validation failed" with a fieldErrors entry for the first required field

steps.name: create with an unknown field
steps.call: createRow({...every required field with sample extra, unknown_field: 1})
steps.expected: strict: 422 "validation failed" with an otherErrors message starting "body.unknown_field: "; otherwise ok, row_rule, and the row has no unknown_field member

skip_rule: The driver records all 20 steps, in this order, every run. A step whose when condition is false is recorded with ok null and its skip reason; that is the only skip. A step that needs the min row or the full row when an earlier step did not create it is recorded with ok false.

skip_reasons.patch null on a field that is not nullab: no field that is not nullable

facts: The driver also prints facts {query, filter, before, not_nullable, required, unique}: whether QUERY, QUERY.filter and QUERY.before are not null and whether a field is not nullable, required or unique. The evidence checker derives the same facts from the prompt (render_reference.spec) and checks that exactly the steps whose when condition is false were skipped.
result: The driver prints {resource, failed, facts, steps} and exits 1 when a step fails. A product passes when the exit code is 0, there are 20 steps named as above, no step has ok false, the skipped steps are exactly those whose when condition is false, and every process run_api_contract.py started is stopped.
scope: Before the freeze it runs for every public v1 to v4 product (run_products.py), against the public Python product. Name cases have no public Python product, so before the freeze only their product gates run. In the M6 acceptance it runs for every acceptance case, name cases included, against the Python product the candidate assembles for the same request without target.
